lines.text: Doing your job description is not quiet quitting. It's the job.
They didn't lay you off. They freed you from a sinking ship.
AI won't take your job. The person using AI will.
Protect your peace like it's the last seat on the lifeboat.
Tired is not a personality trait. Take the PTO.

Promotions don't go to the busiest person.
They go to the most visible one.

Your boss isn't your friend.
Your boss is on the layoff committee.

Six months of savings is more leverage
than ten years of loyalty.

Hustle culture made millionaires of CEOs
and burnouts of employees.

Loyalty to a company that wouldn't replace you in a week
is not virtue.

Your value didn't decrease
the day they cut your role.

If your boss stopped asking your opinion,
update your resume.

The complainer in every 1:1
gets cut first.

Quiet firing is the new
performance review.

Three signs your role is about to be eliminated.
Save this.

Work hard in silence.
Let your success make the noise.
No is a complete sentence.
Stop watering dead plants.

What's meant for you
won't pass you by.

Healing isn't linear.
And look how far you've come.
Hard times create strong people.
Quiet confidence.
You can't pour from an empty cup.
Hurt people hurt people.
Romanticize your life.
Your peace is your power.

Soft life.
Hard boundaries.
Your vibe attracts your tribe.
Self love isn't selfish.

Don't watch the clock.
Do what it does. Keep going.

The only way to do great work
is to love what you do.

Don't stop when you're tired.
Stop when you're done.

Be yourself.
Everyone else is already taken.
Comparison is the thief of joy.
Discipline equals freedom.

She believed she could,
so she did.

Layoffs don't take the worst performers.
They take the most replaceable.

Working late doesn't mean working smart.
It means free labor.

The manager who says 'we're all family here'
is the one who lays you off first.

Passed over twice isn't bad luck.
It's a decision.

Salaries grow 3 percent by staying.
30 percent by leaving.

Stop giving 110 percent.
Your 100 is what they're paying for.

The employee of the month
is the first to burn out.

Success at work is 30 percent skills,
70 percent who sees your work.

If you have to re-earn your job every quarter,
you never had it.

Your promotion isn't given.
It's negotiated.

The best career move you'll ever make
is knowing when to leave.

Coffee badging isn't quiet quitting.
It's protecting your energy.

Bare minimum Mondays.
Maximum output when it matters.

Rage applying at 2 AM
is 2026 career maintenance.

If being cheap is your only edge,
someone cheaper is coming.

Nobody's coming to save your career.
Nobody.

You're not underpaid.
You're under-negotiated.

Your comfort zone pays exactly
what it paid three years ago.

They're not ignoring your work.
You're hiding it.

You didn't get passed over.
You got out-positioned.

You've been 'about to update your resume'
for two years.

Scrolling job posts at midnight
isn't applying.

You know exactly what you should do.
You're just scared to do it.

Busy is not an achievement.
Delivered is.

You're not tired.
You're uninspired and staying anyway.

The raise you're waiting for
went to someone who asked.

Nobody remembers who stayed late.
They remember who delivered.

Stop rehearsing the resignation speech.
Send the application.

Your network isn't small.
You just never message anyone.

Complaining to coworkers changes nothing.
Documenting and leaving does.

HR is not your therapist.
HR protects the company.

Your job title is rented.
Your skills are owned.

Act your wage.
Extra effort is a paid feature.

You're one reorg away from
'we're going in a different direction.'

Career cushioning isn't disloyalty.
It's a seatbelt.

The person who documents
wins the argument three months later.

'Let's circle back' means no.
Learn the language.

Your manager's promise isn't in writing?
It doesn't exist.

Job security died in 2020.
Skill security is the new plan.

They pay you to solve problems,
not to be liked.

Resenteeism: staying at a job
you already quit in your head.

Every 'quick favor' is a job
they didn't want to pay for.

Overtime is a donation to a company
that tracks your sick days.

The loudest person in the meeting
is rarely the smartest. Just the most promoted.

Never fight for a company
that's already interviewing your replacement.

Job hugging a role you hate
is still a dead end.

'Fast-paced environment' means understaffed.
Learn the translation.

The best time to job hunt
is when you don't need to.

Loyalty is a two-way street.
Yours is the only lane open.

Your burnout won't be mentioned at your farewell.
Your replacement starts Monday.

Skills get you hired.
Politics get you promoted. Learn both.

Stop treating your resume like a diary.
It's a sales page.

A raise below inflation
is a pay cut with a thank-you card.

Your boss's boss doesn't know you exist.
That's the actual problem.

Quiet quitting?
They quiet fired you first.

'Other duties as assigned'
is doing three jobs for one salary.

Nobody at work needs to know
everything you're capable of. Yet.

Recognition delayed
is recognition denied.

Exit interviews change nothing.
Exits do.

You can't out-perform a bad manager.
You can only out-leave them.

The 'lazy girl job' trend isn't lazy.
It's correctly priced work.

They replaced someone before you.
They'll replace someone after you.

The salary band was always negotiable.
They just didn't tell you.

Work hard.
But know exactly who's watching before you do.
